name: Hyderabad Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Hira Hall - Sree Sindhi Guru Sangat Sabha
venue.address: 4-1-1106, YWCA Road, Bogulkunta, Hyderguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500001, India

information: Participants needs to pre-register for the event in WCA as they will not be allowed to do any spot registrations on 31st March 2018 to participate. Participation registration for the event closes on 29th March 2018 at 9:00pm IST. Payment also should be made before 29th March 2018 9:00pm IST. Please note once you register in WCA site for the Hyderabad Cube Open 2018, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list in 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation. Additional information will be provided in the tabs.
